mapper.select: select t.ci_id ciId, t.inout_id inoutId, t.community_id communityId, t.car_num carNum, t.car_type carType, t.open_time openTime, t.machine_code machineCode, cip.pay_charge payCharge, cip.real_charge realCharge, cip.pay_type payType, t.remark, t.car_inout carInout, t.pa_id paId, t.state, cip.create_time payTime from car_inout t left join car_inout_payment cip on t.inout_id = cip.inout_id and cip.status_cd = '0' inner join car_inout ci on t.car_num = ci.car_num and ci.car_inout = '3306' and ci.state in ('100300','100400','100600') and t.pa_id = ci.pa_id where t.car_num = #{carNum} and t.car_inout = '3307' and t.state = '100301' and t.open_time > #{openTime} and t.pa_id = #{paId}
